issue: अरुण सदृश सारथी: Aruṇa is himself the Sun's charioteer, so 'like Aruṇa' is odd.
our reading: A charioteer lovely as Aruṇa drives the seven horses.
alternatives: सदृश as filler: 'the lovely charioteer Aruṇa'.

issue: रिपु सों जमलहते: the word division and the sense ('the enemies meet Yama').
our reading: Their enemies meet Yama that very moment.
alternatives: रिपु सों ज मलहते (unclear); 'they are freed from enemies'.

issue: त्वष्टा-वरुण रहत सुउष्णकर: whether सुउष्णकर is an epithet of Tvaṣṭā and Varuṇa or a further name of the Sun, and which limb is meant.
our reading: Tvaṣṭā and Varuṇa, of fair warm rays, dwell there.
alternatives: Suuṣṇakara as a third name dwelling with them.

issue: भानुमान उरसर्म सुउदरचन: a garbled line of the armour; उरसर्म read as उरःशर्म 'guard of the chest'.
our reading: For both hands is Bhānumān, who guards the chest and well protects the belly.
alternatives: Two further names (Uraḥśarma, Sūdaracana?) for chest and belly.

issue: अगहन भिन्न: भिन्न ('other, different') is not a name of the Sun; the month-list wants a name (Mitra in the usual lists of the twelve Ādityas).
our reading: In Agahana he bears another name.
alternatives: A corrupt name (मित्र?) for the Sun of Mārgaśīrṣa.
